description:
FILED s483c (Opus, 2026-09-13) as the PRECISE answer to the conservative fix
#1622 shipped in the same session.

#1622 made a CAPTURE by a nested anon sub disqualify the B regime outright
(`!$captured` on the gate in `Pl::VarAnnotator::_analyze_tree`), because the
term walk never classifies the closure body's reads: `_tw_expr_parse` skips
`sub { ... }` blocks, so a B verdict on a captured name is taken on an
INCOMPLETE use set and can freeze a value whose only surviving use needs the
original (the #1622 reproducer's closure body read is `$cr->()`, a deref --
already a listed disqualifier).

That is correct and over-conservative.  A closure body whose only read is a
LICENSING use should keep the freeze.  Measured on the shipped tree: exactly
one site in the whole product loses a verdict this way --
`cl/pack-impl.pl:789` `_unpack_str`'s `my $slen = length($s)`, captured at
line 858 by `my $get = sub { my $i=$$si_ref+$_[0]; $i<$slen?...:0 }`, whose
read `$i < $slen` is a numeric licensing use.  `cl/pcl-pack.lisp` therefore
went from

    (p-let (($slen :num (%pcl-to-number-strict (p-length $s) "$slen") :captured t))

to a box + `p-my-=`.  Cost at that site: not detectable -- `unpack("H*",
60 kB) x 20` + an A-slice loop measured 33.4 s on the old artifact and 34.7 s
on the new, wall, on a shared box (the in-program timer read the other way,
34 vs 30), i.e. inside the noise.  The 1034-file emission A/B (lib/ 22,
cpan-tests/modules 402, perl's own t/ 604, shapes 6) showed NO other site.

THE FIX (the structural one, CLAUDE.md rule 11 -- do NOT add a second,
textual read classifier beside the walk): make the term walk classify USES
inside a nested anon sub body, and keep #760's narrowing.  Then a captured
name's reads are in the use set like any other and the existing licence /
disqualifier tables decide.  The care needed: descend for USE CLASSIFICATION
ONLY -- the region facts (`nested_sub`, `nested_sub_ev`, `write_fam`,
`init_bad`, `decl_count`) must not double-count, and a `my` of the same name
INSIDE the closure is a different variable (the walk's existing shadowing
rule has to hold across the descent).

BAR: the #1622 guard rows in Pl/t/raw-verdict-01.t must stay green (the
closure-deref case must STILL veto); a new row where a closure body's only
read is licensing and the freeze SURVIVES; corpus-diff + the 1034-file
emission-ab (the only expected mover is cl/pcl-pack.lisp, back to `:num`);
`tools/rebuild-pack`; the full sweep (pack.t is 5600+ rows on that artifact).
SIZE: M.
subject: classify a closure body's READS in the raw-verdict term walk, so #1622's capture veto stops de-optimizing a licensing-use-only capture (one site: pack-impl's $slen)
